subject: Recap & MAP: Cortex Analytics POC — Next steps & stakeholders
messages:
From: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cortexanalytics.com>, Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@cortexanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & MAP: Cortex Analytics POC — Next steps & stakeholders

Hi Liam / Amira —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have aligned owners, dates, and success criteria for the POC. Please review and flag any changes; if this looks correct I can convert to a shared Google Sheet and send calendar invites for the checkpoints.

Key pain points you raised:
- High per-request latency on your current in-house transformer endpoints at 95th percentile; user-facing features are blocked by tail latency.
- Monthly inference spend is growing unpredictably; need levers to control unit cost without quality regressions.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence and VPC connectivity required for the initial evaluation.

Primary goals for the POC (what success looks like)
- Achieve 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for the targeted classification route under realistic traffic profile.
- Reduce per-1000-token inference cost by >= 30% versus current baseline while matching output quality on our sample eval set (metrics: accuracy and hallucination rate).
- Demonstrate a secure connectivity pattern (VPC peering or private link) and provide the requested compliance artifacts.

Proposed MAP (owners and target dates)
1) Kickoff & scope sign-off — Owner: Liam O'Connor (Cortex) / Priyom Das (Redwood) — Target: 2026-02-25
2) Security questionnaire + credentials exchange — Owner: Amira Hassan (Cortex) / Monica Patel (Redwood) — Target: 2026-03-03
3) Environment provisioning (test dataset, model selection, access) — Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood) / Cortex infra lead — Target: 2026-03-10
4) POC execution (2 weeks) & sample runs — Owner: Monica Patel / Cortex data team — Target: 2026-03-24
5) Evaluation & scoring against success criteria — Owner: Liam O'Connor / Priyom Das — Target: 2026-03-27
6) Decision / Procurement (SOW, pricing, legal) — Owner: Cortex procurement / Redwood sales — Target: 2026-04-07

Decision process & stakeholders
- Technical sign-off: CTO (Sarah Patel) and Cortex ML engineering leads.
- Procurement/legal: internal Cortex procurement + legal review for contract terms.
- Executive sponsor: VP Product (Liam will confirm).

Attachments:
- redwood_poc_scope_v1.pdf (scope & model variants)
- cortex_map_v1.xlsx (blank MAP template attached)

Immediate asks for Cortex: please confirm the stakeholders above (CTO, procurement contact, infra lead) and whether the target dates look achievable. If you prefer, we can move the kickoff to 2026-02-26 (Friday) in the morning PT.

Next step from Redwood: I will pull this into a shared MAP doc and provision a short 30-minute kickoff to walk through scope and security details once dates are confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks Priyom — this is great and mirrors how we saw the conversation. A few quick notes / confirmations: 

- Our CTO is Sarah Patel (sarah.patel@cortexanalytics.com) and she will be the technical sign-off. I added Amira (cc) as the security/compliance lead — she'll run the security questionnaire and coordinate with Monica.
- Procurement/legal generally needs 2 weeks for SOW review after we decide; realistic decision target for us is 2026-04-10 (legal buffer), so moving the procurement/contract target to 2026-04-10 works better on our side.
- Monica — can you confirm if Redwood needs sample data in CSV or Parquet for the provisioning step? We can deliver sanitized CSVs by 2026-03-05.

If those adjustments look okay I'll accept this MAP and we can schedule the kickoff for 2026-02-26 at 10:00 AM PT.
